title: Abdali Cuts Through the Caravan and Orders an Encirclement

blocks.text: With the Sikh fighting line separated from the main column, many Pathan troops entered and surrounded the Sikh caravan. Some scattered Sikh counterattacks still break through the pressure, but the attackers keep pouring into the gaps and the noncombatant column is left dangerously exposed.

Abdali presses this advantage again and again until Abdali divided it into two parts, splitting the moving body of the caravan and intensifying the plunder. The scene is one of fragmentation, with the rear guard, the caravan, and the looting Pathans all pulling the struggle in different directions at once.

Even in that disorder the Singhs keep trying to reconnect the broken sections and rescue those being seized. By the close of the page, Abdali and his lieutenants conclude that without a tighter siege and deliberate encirclement the Sikhs will keep slipping through their grasp.
